traps: the same login sample is written twice, as two Go modules that share nothing: 01-Login on Gin with go-oidc and x/oauth2, 01-Login-Quickstart on net/http with the go-auth0 SDK; no go.work, no replace, no import joins them

the module in 01-Login-Quickstart is named myapp, and the module in 01-Login is named 01-Login (not a domain path): its packages import each other as 01-Login/platform/router; both Dockerfiles build a binary called auth0-go-web-app and both exec scripts tag the image auth0-golang-web-app

four Go versions in four files: go 1.19 in 01-Login/go.mod with golang:1.19.3-alpine3.17 in its Dockerfile, go 1.25.0 in 01-Login-Quickstart/go.mod with golang:1.25-alpine in its Dockerfile; no toolchain line, and CI sets up no Go because it builds the two Docker images
Node 20 is written only in .github/workflows/ci.yml (actions/setup-node), for the Playwright tests; tests/package.json has no engines and there is no .nvmrc
tests/ is an npm package with one devDependency and no lockfile (CI runs npm install): resolved is null; it tests whichever of the two apps listens on localhost:3000 and names neither
go.mod lists the indirect requirements in a second require block marked // indirect: 30 in 01-Login, 16 in 01-Login-Quickstart; they are not direct dependencies

the same module is direct in one unit and indirect in the other: golang.org/x/oauth2 is direct in 01-Login (v0.15.0) and indirect in myapp (v0.36.0), github.com/gorilla/sessions is direct in myapp (v1.4.0) and indirect in 01-Login (v1.2.1, through gin-contrib/sessions)
resolved equals declared for the Go modules: go.sum only carries hashes, two lines per module version
Auth0 is in no manifest of 01-Login: it shows only in the AUTH0_* variables of .env.example and in the URLs built from AUTH0_DOMAIN (the OIDC issuer, /v2/logout); only myapp declares an Auth0 SDK

jQuery 3.1.0, Bootstrap 3.3.7 and Font Awesome 4.7.0 come from CDNs in the 01-Login templates and are in no manifest; js.cookie.js (JavaScript Cookie v2.1.3) is a checked-in copy; the Quickstart templates carry only inline CSS
the .html files are Go html/template files ({{ .nickname }}), loaded with LoadHTMLGlob and template.ParseGlob; Linguist still calls them HTML
myapp has no web framework: it routes with http.NewServeMux from the standard library, so frameworks has no entry for it

01-Login signs its session cookie with the literal key "secret" (router.go) and fails to start without a .env file; myapp reads SESSION_SECRET and treats .env as optional; 01-Login/.dockerignore does not exclude .env, the Quickstart one does
the 01-Login .gitignore and .dockerignore name src/ and pkg/, which do not exist; the Quickstart ones name a myapp binary
dependabot.yml watches only the two gomod directories and ignores major and patch updates; the npm package in tests/ is not watched
languages lists programming and markup languages only; YAML, JSON, Markdown and go.mod/go.sum files are present and not listed
the semgrep workflow runs in the returntocorp/semgrep image with no tag: no version to record
